title: Offers, courtesy, and choice limitations
summary: Feedback on offers, apologies, courtesy support, and available choices is fragmented, with one clear positive note on leasing value, one clear complaint about lack of a courtesy car, and several remarks whose sentiment cannot be determined from the excerpts alone.

positive.summary: The positive review praises an excellent leasing offer as the main reason for choosing the car.

negative.summary: The negative review criticizes the lack of a courtesy car for a very new vehicle as poor service.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined excerpts mention offers, apologies, and missing choices such as the absence of a particular option or only automatic transmission, but the snippets are too brief to confirm overall sentiment.

limitations: Most excerpts are classified as undetermined, so the topic has limited interpretable sentiment evidence.
The topic combines several loosely related subjects, including leasing offers, courtesy support after service issues, apologies, and drivetrain or transmission choice.
Several snippets are too short or context-free to tell whether the reviewer’s overall view is positive, negative, or merely rhetorical.
